gaps.description: Formula Ford 2020 official grid/start import is complete for 1148 race/heat rows. The remaining 12 classified race/heat rows are held out because the official source family exposes reserve-only entries, restart-grid-only positions, or original-grid rows that do not safely match the classified driver/car row. These rows remain explicit holdouts instead of guessed grid/start positions. Lap-analysis imports remain scoped to Bryce-labeled blocks; continuation pages without a repeated Bryce label stay held out until a layout-aware parser can match them deterministically.
